Author: Sonia Gokani
Bench: Sonia Gokani
 R/Cr.Ma/15060/2018 Order

IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CRIMINAL MISC.APPLICATION NO. 15060 of 2018 ==========================================================
 STATE OF GUJARAT  Versus  UMESHBHAI DHARAMSINHBHAI MAKWANA ==========================================================
Appearance:
MR H S SONI, ADDL. PUBLIC PROSECUTOR(2) for the PETITIONER(s) No.
1  for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1,2 ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MS JUSTICE SONIA GOKANI  Date : 20/08/2018  ORAL ORDER 1.Aggrieved by the judgment and order of acquittal rendered on 17.03.2018, by the learned  Additional Sessions Judge, Bhavnagar while dealing with Criminal Appeal No.63 of  2016, arising out of the offence punishable under section 16(A) for breach of Sections  7(1) and 2(1)(a)(j) of the of the Prevention of Food Adulteration  Act, 1954, the present application for Leave to Appeal under Section 378 (4) of the  Code of Criminal Procedure has been preferred by the applicantoriginal complainant.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2.Mr.Hardik Soni, learned Additional Public R/CR.MA/15060/2018 ORDER Prosecutor for  respondentState has taken this Court through judgment and order dated 17.03.2018  passed in Criminal Appeal NO.63 of 2016 by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, 
Bhavnagar, where it has upturned the decision of the learned Principal Civil Judge and  Judicial Magistrate First Clas, Sihor, District Bhavnagar.
He has urged that the Court  on an erroneous interpretation of the evidence which had been adduced and on wrong  application of provisions and the rules has given acquittal.

sentences.text:
3.Having perused the judgment and order of both the Courts and also on considering  the submissions of learned Additional Public Prosecutor, this Court deems it appropriate  to grant the Leave to Appeal. 
4.Hence, the present application is allowed.
The applicant is granted Leave to Appeal.

(MS SONIA GOKANI, J) M.M.MIRZA State Of Gujarat vs Umeshbhai Dharamsinhbhai Makwana on 20 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72957139/
